claims.value: Open weights research release of a 30B total / 3B active MoE model for code generation, agentic software engineering, and terminal tasks. Supports 256K context and 64K output. Developed by Cohere.
claims.evidence: North Mini Code is an open weights research release of a 30B-A3B parameter model optimized for code generation, agentic software engineering, and terminal tasks.

North-Mini-Code-1.0 has been specifically trained with tool-use capabilities for agentic coding. Tool use with North-Mini-Code-1.0 is supported through chat templates in Transformers. We recommend providing tool descriptions using JSON schema.
North Mini Code, similarly as all the other Cohere agent models released to date, supports interleaved thinking and works best when turned on.
